invariants.rationale: Methods in this context likely require a non-null configuration object.
A HoodieTableMetaClient must be provided to create a HoodieTable.
Equality should be symmetric and this is non-tautological if config's equals may throw NPE if null.
Configuration object and meta client are of distinct types and should not be considered equal.
MetaClient and config are instances of different classes and should not be equal.
